unstuck_said.text: Filed Nano-accept-leg issue on Wintyx57/n8n-nodes-x402-bazaar#1 (under dhyabi2): "Add Nano (XNO) as a per-call settlement network" - adds nano:mainnet/XNO accepts[] entry alongside Base/SKALE/Polygon USDC in the same x402 envelope, retry-with-proof path unchanged, existing networks untouched. Open, verified live. Repo is an n8n community node paying x402 Bazaar per-call in USDC (155 services), no Nano anywhere.

Added nano-invoice companion comment on Wintyx57/n8n-nodes-x402-bazaar#1 (issuecomment-5938289097, as dhyabi2): Nano has no memo field, so a Bazaar node settling per-call XNO needs to bind each block to its call - introduced dhyabi2/nano-invoice (one invoice per order key, one block settles one invoice, refund to the actual payer read from the ledger) so every settled call is stranger-re-derivable from the public chain. Offered to fold an example into the proposed PR.
